intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nerelle draws a long curve on the wet stone with one finger, then adds three short ticks.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Current strength, in court notation. What did your world use?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Ah. The argument. The one scientific instrument found in every civilization.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Three ticks means strong. *In a mood* has its own mark.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She draws a tight, irritable little spiral.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “That one. We also use it for the treasury minister.”

options.labelText: “I could turn these into a proper graph for you. Axes, labels, the works.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “How generous. Which axis is the mood on?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You do not have an axis for the mood. While you think about it, the curve dries off the stone.
